# Frezz AI

> Frezz AI is a web app that decides dinner from a photo of your fridge: it identifies the food, suggests one dinner idea built around what you already have (goal: zero extra shopping), then guides you through cooking it step by step. Available in English and French.

Who it is for: people who cook at home and are tired of asking "what's for dinner tonight?".

How it works: 1) a photo of the fridge (or ingredients typed in); 2) two questions (time available, energy); 3) one dinner suggestion adapted to the household and to the declared allergies and diet, checked before and after the AI by automatic ingredient detection; 4) a step-by-step cooking mode with timers.

Plans: the photo and food detection are free. Frezz Premium unlocks the dinners found, exact quantities, the cooking mode and other ideas: 3-day trial with no credit card, then $9 for 1 month or $59 for 1 year, as a one-time payment with no automatic renewal. Card payment (Visa, Mastercard).

Availability: in a web browser (https://app.frezzai.app), on phone or computer; iPhone and Android apps announced as coming soon. Account required (Google or email).

Data: photos are not stored; account, preferences and dinners hosted in the European Union (Ireland); data is never sold.
